name: sukoon-health
description: Healthcare discovery and booking platform (working name: Sukoon Health)

scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.setup:demo: bash scripts/require-seed-password.sh && npm run db:seed -w backend && npm run db:seed:demo-doctor -w backend && npm run db:seed-public-holidays -w backend && npm run db:refresh-next-available -w backend
scripts.setup:demo:video: bash scripts/require-seed-password.sh && npm run db:seed -w backend && npm run db:seed:demo-doctor:video -w backend && npm run db:seed-public-holidays -w backend && npm run db:refresh-next-available -w backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run format:check
